disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing in violation of the provisions of sections 60A to 60J or board rules and regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: that the holder of such certificate of registration is practicing in the commonwealth in violation of any provision of sections sixty A to sixty J, inclusive, or of any rule or regulation promulgated under authority thereof by the board
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 60g - Revocation, Suspension or Annulment of Certificate of Registration as Architect; Disciplining of Registrant; Grounds

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate of registration was obtained by fraud or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: that such certificate of registration was obtained by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 60g - Revocation, Suspension or Annulment of Certificate of Registration as Architect; Disciplining of Registrant; Grounds

disciplinary_grounds.description: Money or thing of value, other than prescribed fees, was paid or received to secure the issuance of the certificate of registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: that any money or thing of value, except fees prescribed or authorized by said sections, was paid or received to secure the issuance of such certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 60g - Revocation, Suspension or Annulment of Certificate of Registration as Architect; Disciplining of Registrant; Grounds

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of fraud, deceit, gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: that the holder of such certificate of registration has been guilty of fraud or deceit, or of gross negligence, incompetence or misconduct, in the practice of architecture
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 60g - Revocation, Suspension or Annulment of Certificate of Registration as Architect; Disciplining of Registrant; Grounds

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted or suffered his official seal to be affixed to plans, specifications, or drawings not prepared by him or under his personal supervision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: that the holder of such certificate of registration has permitted or suffered his official seal to be affixed to any plans, specifications or drawings not prepared by him or under his personal supervision by his regularly employed subordinates
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 60g - Revocation, Suspension or Annulment of Certificate of Registration as Architect; Disciplining of Registrant; Grounds

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affixed his signature to plans, drawings, or specifications not prepared by him or in his office, or permitted his name to be used to assist a non-architect to evade the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: that the holder of a certificate has affixed his signature to plans, drawings, specifications or other instruments of service which have not been prepared by him or in his office, or under his immediate and responsible direction, or has permitted his name to be used for the purpose of assisting any person, not an architect, to evade the provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 60g - Revocation, Suspension or Annulment of Certificate of Registration as Architect; Disciplining of Registrant; Grounds

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder has an interest in the manufacture, sale, or installation of any component or process in a project for which he is the architect, which interest he has not disclosed to his client.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: that the holder of such certificate has an interest in the manufacture, sale or installation of any component or process in a project for which he is the architect, which interest he has not disclosed to his client in such manner as the board shall by regulation prescribe
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 60g - Revocation, Suspension or Annulment of Certificate of Registration as Architect; Disciplining of Registrant; Grounds

seal_required.quote: All plans and specifications and reports prepared by a registered architect, or under his supervision shall be stamped with the impression of such seal.
